data.name: Merugu
data.gender_notes: Merugu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Merugu is derived from the Tamil word 'Meru', which means mountain, and the prefix 'Gu' meaning god. This name is believed to represent the God of Mercy. The name is also associated with the concept of protection and is often used as a term of endearment. The name Merugu carries the meaning “God of Mercy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Tamil, Hindi. Parents who choose Merugu usually hope their child will grow to embody god of mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Merugu belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Mercy.”

The name carries the connotation of divine strength, stability, and spiritual elevation, making it a source of pride for families with this lineage.
